# /crav1-design-ui

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Design the UI before the plan](../../from-design-ui.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-design-ui/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Design a slice's user-facing screens after the spec is accepted and before the plan, with one sign-off item per screen.

Skips a slice that clearly has no UI; when unclear it asks once (design, or `UI: none (<reason>)`). `ui/design.md` holds the look, layout per screen and the tokens (one `yaml` block: colours, typography, spacing, radius). `ui/experience.md` holds each `### <name> (S<n>)` with at least the empty, loading, error and full-of-data states, its interactions, and yes/no checks `(S1-C1)`. The Markdown wins over any picture.

One visual, always: an HTML mock under `ui/mock/` (zoom, docking, motion, a clickable flow; never shipped, not a plan input), PlantUML Salt (static layout), or Mermaid (flows and states); text art only when none renders.

`scripts/ui_screens.py sync --yes` adds one Approval needed item per screen through `approval_needed.py` `add_item`, with a `Screen:` mark. A material change to a signed-off screen appends `Cleared:`; a typo keeps the yes, and the script says why. A new screen gets its own item. It never writes `Approved:` and never stores a screenshot.

## Choice words

Exact words for bots and scripted runs (no `--flags`). A word in the invocation takes that choice without asking. A headless or bot run with no word stops and names the valid words.

| Question | Word | Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The HTML mock (optional; a word in the invocation takes that choice without asking) | `with-mock` | also write the throwaway HTML mock under `ui/mock/` (never shipped, not a plan input) |
| The HTML mock (optional; a word in the invocation takes that choice without asking) | `skip-mock` | no HTML mock this run; the visual is PlantUML Salt, Mermaid, or text art inside the Markdown |

With no word, the visual card asks. When the spec names a screen and has no ui/ files and no UI: none line, one card asks first: design (Recommended) or no-ui. A run with no person in the chat writes nothing and names with-mock and skip-mock.

## Runs when

An accepted spec has a user-facing UI to design before the plan. Called by the user. [`/crav1-tighten-and-plan-ready-to-build`](crav1-tighten-and-plan-ready-to-build.md) opens it on its own before the plan when the slice has a UI.

## Prompts

One card when a UI is unclear, one batch for the visual (and the signer when the spec names none), one closing yes. A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: Spec, existing `ui/` files, UI patterns in `docs/system/` and the code.

Reads `spec.md`, the slice's `ui/` files and their Approval needed items, UI patterns in `docs/system/`, and the existing screens in code when `## In the code` names paths. Looks at a screenshot only to understand feedback.

## Writes

In short: `ui/design.md`, `ui/experience.md`, one visual (Salt or Mermaid in them, or `ui/mock/`), one Approval needed item per screen, or one `UI: none` line.

After one closing yes: `ui/design.md`, `ui/experience.md`, the mock under `ui/mock/` when chosen, and through `ui_screens.py sync --yes` one Approval needed item per new screen, a refreshed `Screen:` mark, or a `Cleared:` mark. On the skip path one `UI: none (<reason>)` line.

## Does not

Leaves requirements, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `docs/system/`, code, and `Approved:` lines alone. Writes no binary file. Does not commit.

Limits and exceptions: Refuses application code. A new requirement goes to [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md). Not a starter option. Runs before [`/crav1-design-architecture`](crav1-design-architecture.md) when both apply.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-record-approval`](crav1-record-approval.md); [`/crav1-plan-from-spec`](crav1-plan-from-spec.md); [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill. It names [`/crav1-record-approval`](crav1-record-approval.md) and [`/crav1-plan-from-spec`](crav1-plan-from-spec.md).
